world_org_meetings.title: UK and EU agree draft deal to scrap Brexit red tape over food exports
world_org_meetings.description: The food deal, ahead of a UK-EU summit later this month, is the most significant part of the so-called Brexit reset agreed so far.

world_org_meetings.title: Secretary Rubio has a tough time getting officials at G20 on the same page
world_org_meetings.description: U.S. Secretary of State Marco Rubio is hosting the G20 foreign ministers' meeting in Atlanta, with a focus on economic and security challenges.

world_org_meetings.title: EU diplomats object to G20 photo with Lavrov, prompting US cancellation
world_org_meetings.description: The meeting in Atlanta will go ahead as planned, ahead of a G20 leaders’ summit hosted by President Donald Trump at his Miami golf club in December.

world_org_meetings.title: G20 'family photo' cancelled after protests over presence of Russian minister
world_org_meetings.description: UK Foreign Secretary Ed Miliband confronted his Russian counterpart at the meeting and accused his government of killing innocent civilians in Ukraine.

world_org_meetings.title: Russia's presence divides G20 ministers
world_org_meetings.description: The G20 foreign ministers’ meeting in the US is wrapping up two days of talks without agreement on several key global security issues. On the sidelines, US Secretary of State Marco Rubio signed an Arctic cooperation deal with Japan and South Korea and confirmed Washington’s participation in Riyadh’s World Expo in 2030. Meanwhile, European ministers confronted Russia’s Sergei Lavrov over the war in Ukraine and refused to join him for the traditional group photo. Jack Pownall reports.

diplomatic_visits.title: Police in Scotland to escort fire crews in latest crackdown on Bonfire Night disorder
diplomatic_visits.description: As many as 1,700 officers could be deployed in the biggest Police Scotland operation since last year's visit by President Trump.

diplomatic_visits.title: Jimmy Kimmel roasts Trump in late night monologue amid 'blue tsunami' midterms
diplomatic_visits.description: Late night host Jimmy Kimmel had some choice words for U.S. President Donald Trump last night as a “blue tsunami” stormed the country during the U.S. elections, quipping in the monologue of ABC's Jimmy Kimmel Live! that Trump was "already running out of dipping sauce containers to throw at the television set."

diplomatic_visits.title: Syria, Saudi Arabia sign defence cooperation deal, agree $403m in loans
diplomatic_visits.description: Defence cooperation deal signed as Syria's President al-Sharaa visits Riyadh for the second time in less than a month.

diplomatic_visits.title: Swiss foreign minister makes first North Korea visit since 2003 as diplomatic office reopens
diplomatic_visits.description: Switzerland is renewing direct talks with North Korea as tensions rise on the peninsula. Seoul hopes the Swiss office will help it engage with Pyongyang.

diplomatic_visits.title: Germany's chancellor called for Korean unity. Does Seoul want that?
diplomatic_visits.description: Germany, like Korea, was once divided by rival political systems and by one of the world's most fortified borders. Chancellor Merz called for a reunified Korea during his recent visit — but the prospect seems faint.

elections.title: What Democrats can and can't do with their new power after taking Congress
elections.description: Democrats can vote legislation through. But Trump still has veto power.

elections.title: Control of Congress is at stake today. And, judge to consider motion in Clancy case
elections.description: Election Day is here, and voters are heading to the polls in an election that may change control of Congress. And, a judge is considering whether to dismiss Lindsay Clancy's murder case.

elections.title: Elon Musk gets little bang for his buck in U.S. midterms, with possible Democratic investigations to come
elections.description: As Republicans suffered a landslide defeat and Texas elected its first Democratic governor in more than three decades, one of the biggest losers of the U.S. midterms was not on the ballot: billionaire Elon Musk.

elections.title: South Africans vote in local elections that could continue decline of ANC
elections.description: South Africans are voting in local elections that test the African National Congress party, or ANC, which has seen declining support over the last decade

elections.title: Why South Africa's local elections matter
elections.description: South Africans head to the polls on Wednesday amid water shortages, frustration with local services and questions over whether the ANC's support will keep falling.
